Sherjeel Hussain

Multidisciplinary Designer working across digital and physical form. Trained in industrial design and ceramic craft — one day its websites, UI, and brand identity, the next its pots, furniture, and plastics. Based in Glasgow, Scotland.

Everything ever made is designed and built. The split between physical and digital is a false one. I believe in a more holistic approach to design, everything that can be, will be made.
